# Architecture Overview

This project has been audited by JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1.

- **DNA Summary:** Next.js 16+, React 19.2+, Tailwind CSS v4, OKLCH Light Mode.

The design system follows the Swiss Light Design Doctrine with OKLCH chromatic structures.
